purpose: Run the controlled-U to frozen factorized-R to K to scored-QA bridge once under the prospectively frozen soft-gate vertical-slice policy.

architecture.factorized_relevance: Frozen terminal v12.1 step40 route and actor heads with their exact ORION LoRA and relevance queries.
architecture.language_input: Frozen ORION visual tokens plus frozen U tokens plus trainable K bridge tokens.

data_scope.language_evaluation: One fixed first keyframe per event and scored target/counterfactual answers with a no-U ablation.

hard_stop_conditions: Any frozen input, checkpoint, protocol, preflight or launch hash differs.
Shared R is not bitwise exact across matched U variants.
Zero U or zero K is not exact.
On/off-path controls differ in consumer-grid mass, peak or support count, or are not spatially distinct.
A map, loss, gradient or required output is non-finite.
A gradient escapes TaskRiskLanguageBridge or an interface tensor shape differs.
soft_diagnostics: Train/dev on-path over off-path ordering and off-path risk ceiling.
All factorized-R per-component, per-view and per-event quality metrics.
Scored QA target preference, target NLL improvement and no-U contrast.
Central-rear braking/yield versus matched zero/off-path semantic behavior.

training.event_sampling: one event per step in deterministic round-robin order, shuffled keyframes within event

required_outputs: spatial_u_r_k_maps.pt with route/actor R, union R, U and K
report.json with structured fields, scored QA, no-U ablation, per-variant/event diagnostics and rear probe

downstream_policy.semantic_quality_passes: Record the controlled bridge as viable and prepare a separately hash-bound Stage2-P interface smoke.
downstream_policy.semantic_quality_fails_but_integrity_pas: Carry the labeled bridge into one bounded Stage2-P interface smoke under the soft-gate policy; do not claim semantic quality.
downstream_policy.hard_integrity_fails: Stop the vertical slice and repair the earliest invalid interface before any downstream run.

claim_boundary: A completed run is one controlled-U semantic engineering slice. It does not validate learned U, formal language generalization, planning, closed loop or safety.
